tool.name: source_map_probe
tool.description:
Probe a target for accessible `*.js.map` (source-map) files.
Production builds frequently ship source maps to clients by accident — `app.js.map` reveals the full pre-minified source including baked-in constants, internal API shapes, and sometimes secrets. This is one of the highest-leverage info-disclosure classes for modern SPA targets.
Strategy: 1. Fetch the target HTML and harvest `` URLs (same-origin only). 2. For each script, attempt `.map`. 3. Probe ~23 well-known bundle-name candidates at common asset roots (`/app.js.map`, `/main.js.map`, `/static/js/main.js.map`, `/dist/bundle.js.map`, etc.). 4. For each 200 hit, validate v3 source-map shape (object with `version` + either `sources` OR `sourcesContent`). 5. Scan `sourcesContent[]` (when present) for secret-indicator tokens (`api_key`, `aws_secret`, `Bearer`, `ghp_*`, `sk_(live|test)_*`, etc.).
Findings: - **Medium** (CWE-540, info_disclosure) per accessible source-map. The pre- minified source — file paths, variable names, internal structure — is recovered. - **High** (CWE-200, secret_leak, `verification_status=needs_review`) when `sourcesContent[]` contains secret-indicator tokens. Same heuristic as `code_search_for_domain` — false positives acceptable; the agent verifies.
Snippets are bounded at 120 chars and stripped of newlines; **full source bodies are NEVER returned** in findings (only file paths + the matched ≤120-char window around each indicator). Cookie / auth values never appear.
Composes with cluster-A safety (auth-injection / exclude-path / rate-limit) automatically. Each finding carries `description_plain` + `recommended_action` + `fix_time_estimate=1hr` (production-build config flag).
Use after the BFS crawler discovers a deep web target; one call per host.

parameter.name: target_url
parameter.description: Target URL. The HTML at this URL is fetched + scanned for `` attributes; each in-scope script URL is probed at `.map`. The origin root is also probed against a curated bundle-name candidate list. Plain hostnames get `https://` prefixed.

parameter.name: extra_urls
parameter.description: Comma-separated extra map URLs to probe (absolute or origin-relative). Use when the agent already knows a non-standard bundle path discovered through other recon (e.g. fingerprint output). Off-origin entries dropped.

returns.description:
{success, target_url, probed, hits: [{url, source_count, has_sources_content, sample_sources, secret_hits}], errors, stats}.
Findings are emitted as side effects via the tracer. Always returns success=True even when the target is unreachable — read the structured fields rather than branching.
